_doc: Pontifex bundle pin (PROGRAMME-PRESERVATION-PROTOCOL §0.6 / AGENTS.md Rule 4). Declares the Codex build artefact this MCP serves. Materialized + maintained by scripts/sync-bundle.mjs (digest-verified against the artefact .sha256), validated by scripts/verify-consumed-bundle.mjs (run in `npm run check`). source: dev-build = cycle snapshot; release = formal vX.Y.Z. release_sha256 is the verified artefact digest — never invented.

alignment_policy.follows: mcp-stable pointer (Codex-moved; deliberate production-readiness signal — never auto-follow latest/HEAD)
alignment_policy.additive: minor/patch contract bump → align (fetch + verify sha256 + validate contract version + update pin + acceptance-suite smoke-test + log)
alignment_policy.breaking: major contract bump → gate: halt and re-validate serving-logic before pinning (Pontifex + programme lead)
alignment_policy.paper_bundles: paper-*-kg-input-* tags are immutable and never auto-updated (protocol §5.1/§5.2)
